channel.description: বাংলাদেশ, ভারত ও বিশ্বের সর্বশেষ খবর — স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে আপডেটেড

item.title: Yemeni Authorities Report Missile Strikes on Aden Facility
item.description: Yemen's administration stated that Houthi rebels launched a pair of missiles targeting the airport in Aden. This incident coincides with governmental claims of military progress and hundreds of enemy casualties in Marib.

item.title: Football Rumors: Bellingham Extension and Transfer Interest
item.description: Reports indicate Real Madrid player Jude Bellingham is prepared to extend his stay with the Spanish team. Meanwhile, other clubs are monitoring transfer valuations and situations for players at Arsenal, Liverpool, Manchester United, Chelsea, and Barcelona.

item.title: Political Clash in India Over Substance Abuse Issues
item.description: Prior to upcoming elections, Amit Shah criticized the administration led by Chief Minister Mann concerning the local drug problem. In response, the state leader pointed to narcotics seizures occurring in Gujarat.

item.title: Medical Milestone Achieved for Adolescent Pancreatic Care
item.description: },Pinnacle Hospital successfully utilized an advanced endoscopic technique to address a pancreatic tumor in a young patient.

item.title: New Facility Opens for Weight Management and Metabolic Care
item.description: Kauvery Hospital has inaugurated a specialized unit dedicated to treating individuals suffering from obesity and associated medical conditions. A multidisciplinary staff will deliver comprehensive treatment options.

item.title: Upcoming Bengaluru Summit to Prioritize Labor Force Evolution
item.description: A government minister announced that the upcoming Bengaluru Skill Summit will center its discussions on modernizing and transforming the regional workforce.

item.title: Allegations Surround Toll Collection Practices by NICE
item.description: Politician H.D. Kumaraswamy claimed that NICE has improperly gathered 4,756 crore rupees in toll fees since 2008, breaching the established guidelines of the project.

item.title: Judicial Withdrawal in Delhi Gymkhana Club Eviction Matter
item.description: A high court magistrate has stepped down from presiding over the legal proceedings regarding the eviction of the Delhi Gymkhana Club.

item.title: Arakkonam Police Detain Three Men Over Illegal Pill Possession
item.description: Authorities apprehended three young individuals in Arakkonam carrying illicit narcotics. Law enforcement reported that the suspects intended to traffic the pharmaceuticals in Chennai.

item.title: Government Lowers Postgraduate Dental Entrance Mark Requirements
item.description: Authorities have reduced the qualifying mark thresholds for postgraduate dental courses. This decision was implemented following a high volume of unfilled positions.

item.title: Tourism Minister Calls for Faster Eco-Tourism Progress at Estate
item.description: The Tourism Minister instructed administrative personnel to speed up ecological tourism projects at the Roerich-Devika Rani property. Officials shared photographic documentation via email.

item.title: Bengaluru Set to Exhibit New Numismatic Artwork
item.description: A newly created piece of coin-based art is scheduled for public presentation in Bengaluru. The forthcoming exhibition highlights works crafted from currency and tokens.

item.title: Building Collapse in New Seemapuri Leaves Three Dead, Including Kids
item.description: Three individuals, including two minors, died when the front section of a four-floor structure fell in northeast Delhi's New Seemapuri around 3 p.m. Emergency responders are currently conducting rescue operations at the site.

item.title: Conservative Chief Badenoch Rejects Renewing Brexit Discussions
item.description: Tory leader Badenoch called revisiting the Brexit issue a dreadful mistake. She cited the extensive time previously wasted debating internally and with the European Union.

item.title: Delhi Police Require Ten-Day Notice for Jantar Mantar Demonstrations
item.description: Delhi Police stated that applications for gatherings at Jantar Mantar must be submitted ten days prior. The rule follows heightened central security amid planned political protests.

item.title: WHO Seeks Clarity From Russia on Lab Worker Plague Fatality
item.description: A senior WHO official stated the agency lacks precise details regarding the plague-related death of a Russian laboratory employee on October 2. The organization has requested additional data from Moscow.

item.title: Madurai Authorities Plan Large Private Sector Job Fair for Oct 10
item.description: Officials in Madurai are organizing a major employment event aimed at connecting job seekers with private companies on October 10.

item.title: Four Minors Face Charges Under POCSO Legislation
item.description: Law enforcement has registered cases against four young boys invoking the provisions of the POCSO Act.

item.title: Manipur Women’s Wing Backs MP Bimol Akoijam Amid JNU Allegations
item.description: Following sexual harassment accusations by students, Jawaharlal Nehru University terminated the parliamentarian on October 9, prompting local women's support.

item.title: Murali Criticizes Central Government Over AIIMS Policies
item.description: Leader Murali has publicly condemned the central administration for maintaining an inflexible position regarding AIIMS.

item.title: Educational Technology Startup byteXL Secures $9 Million Funding
item.description: The digital learning enterprise byteXL has successfully obtained $9 million in financial backing.

item.title: Pilikula Authority Hosts World Space Week Event Emphasizing Science
item.description: The Pilikula Development Authority held a two-day World Space Week program starting October 7, where officials stressed fostering scientific curiosity.

item.title: Technopark Welcomes New Branch of State Central Library
item.description: A fresh facility belonging to the State Central Library has officially opened its doors within the Technopark premises.

item.title: Space Agency Researchers Spearhead Awareness March in Rajamahendravaram
item.description: Personnel from ISRO directed a public procession focused on space education through the streets of Rajamahendravaram.

item.title: Nepal Seeks Law Changes to Register Deaths of Thousands Missing Since August Floods
item.description: Authorities in Nepal are updating disaster and registration legislation. The legal adjustments aim to help relatives officially record the deaths of 5,285 individuals still unaccounted for following the August 26 floods.

item.title: Hyderabad Authorities Issue Notices to Four Pharmacies Over Habit-Forming Drug Records
item.description: Four drugstores in Hyderabad have received official notices regarding their documentation of controlled substances. The action focuses on their sales records for habit-forming medications.

item.title: Anantapur Health Camp Provides Free Medical Screenings to Around 600 Youths
item.description: Organized for the Nigama Foundation's anniversary, a medical camp delivered complimentary health checks to roughly 600 students and young people. Services included eye exams, diabetes tests, orthopaedic consultations, and general physical assessments.

item.title: GITAM and Pfizer Team Up to Provide Pharma Industry Training for Rural Women
item.description: Pharmaceutical giant Pfizer has collaborated with GITAM to offer professional training programs. The initiative is designed to prepare women from rural areas for careers in the pharmaceutical sector.

item.title: Replit Ends Partnership with Anthropic, CEO Confirms
item.description: Replit's chief executive stated that the company has terminated its collaboration with Anthropic, citing financial factors among multiple motives. Although Replit teamed up with OpenAI in August, the end of the Anthropic alliance was not previously disclosed.

item.title: Former Additional Secretary Found Injured at Dhaka Officers Club Construction Site
item.description: A former additional secretary was discovered bleeding at an Officers Club building under construction and later died at a hospital. Police noted that security footage captured the official repeatedly moving up and down the structure.

item.title: New Delhi Dismisses Opposition Criticism Regarding S Jaishankar's Meeting with Marco Rubio
item.description: The administration countered opposition criticism by justifying the Mumbai encounter between Jaishankar and Rubio. Officials pointed to past precedents of foreign dignitaries being received outside the capital.

item.title: Meta Staffers Indicate Lula's Brazil Election Accounts Were Limited, Report Claims
item.description: According to a Brazilian newspaper citing internal communications, Meta workers stated that Lula's profiles faced restrictions during the electoral period. Meanwhile, the platform actively promoted content associated with Bolsonaro.

item.title: Al Jazeera Personnel Targeted by Israeli Spyware Attack in 2024
item.description: In 2024, Israeli spyware firms deployed a novel zero-click technique known as adfection to infiltrate the mobile devices of Al Jazeera employees.

item.title: Top Ten Premier League Substitute Players of All Time Evaluated
item.description: Football analysts are ranking the ten most impactful substitute players in the history of the Premier League based on their performances coming off the bench.

item.title: Historic Estelle Clark Estate in Ojai Sells for $4.6 Million
item.description: The landmark Tudor Revival property originally built for silent-film star Estelle Clark in Ojai has sold for $4.6 million after starting at $6.495 million.

item.title: Dragons Overcome Half-Time Deficit to Defeat Perpignan
item.description: The Dragons secured a victory against Perpignan at Rodney Parade during their Challenge Cup opening fixture, though they missed out on a bonus point.

item.title: Jaminet stars as Toulon beat Edinburgh in Challenge Cup
item.description: As reported by BBC Sport, Edinburgh suffer their first defeat of the season as they go down to Toulon in their European Challenge Cup opener. Key points: Jaminet, Toulon, Edinburgh, Challenge Cup Edinburgh.

item.title: US Lawmakers Urge FBI To Probe Illinois Temple Plot As Federal Hate Crime
item.description: As reported by NDTV, They also asked the FBI and the Justice Department to "share timely threat information with state and local law enforcement and with Hindu temples, Sikh gurdwaras, and other South Asian houses of worship, and offer them protective resources. Key points: Lawmakers Urge, To Probe Illinois Temple Plot As Federal Hate Crime They, Justice Department, Hindu.

item.title: মিয়ানমারের জান্তা–সমর্থিত সরকারের সঙ্গে টোকিওতে যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের গোপন বৈঠক
item.description: Prothom Alo-এর প্রতিবেদন অনুযায়ী, আগের বৈঠকের মতো টোকিও বৈঠকেও নেতৃত্ব দেন যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের পররাষ্ট্র দপ্তরের গোয়েন্দা ও গবেষণাবিষয়ক সহকারী পররাষ্ট্রমন্ত্রী মাইকেল ভ্যান্স। এ ঘটনায় আলোচিত: যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের, মিয়ানমারের, জান্তা, সমর্থিত।

item.title: Gloucester and holders Bordeaux draw Champions Cup thriller
item.description: As reported by BBC Sport, Gloucester and holders Bordeaux Begles begin this season's Champions Cup with a thrilling 36. Key points: Gloucester, Bordeaux, Champions Cup, Bordeaux Begles.

item.title: Two tracks from Wu-Tang Clan's rare Shaolin album become public
item.description: Two excerpts from the notoriously restricted Wu-Tang Clan album 'Once Upon A Time in Shaolin' have finally been made available for listening.

item.title: European students protest for educational reforms
item.description: Student demonstrators across multiple European nations are staging protests and clashing with authorities to demand improved educational systems.

item.title: India includes Bumrah and Pant for New Zealand Tests
item.description: Pacer Jasprit Bumrah will spearhead the bowling lineup for the upcoming two-match Test series against New Zealand. While omitted from the ODI roster, wicketkeeper Rishabh Pant also joins the Test squad.

item.title: Asleep Tesla driver crashes into patrol vehicles using FSD
item.description: A motorist admitted to being asleep while utilizing Tesla's driver-assist feature before colliding with highway patrol vehicles in California.

item.title: Gaza faces food supply concerns after commercial blocks
item.description: Commercial shipments including produce, meat, and winter apparel have been blocked from entering the Gaza Strip for forty-eight hours.

item.title: Former military officer discovered shot dead in Hyderabad
item.description: Authorities in Hyderabad are investigating the fatal shooting of a retired Army officer, with suicide considered the primary theory.

item.title: Lockheed Martin historical thruster vehicle resembles flying Tesla
item.description: Decades-old engineering by Lockheed Martin utilized thrusters on vehicles, drawing comparisons to concepts involving Tesla Roadsters.

item.title: সাম্রাজ্যবাদীদের মধ্যে গভীর ঐক্য রয়েছে: আনু মুহাম্মদ
item.description: ভারত, পাকিস্তান, ফ্রান্স ও বেলজিয়ামে চলা ছাত্র আন্দোলনের সঙ্গে সংহতি প্রকাশ করে এই মন্তব্য করেন আনু মুহাম্মদ।

item.title: Oregon town remembers victims of elementary school shooting
item.description: Residents in Bend, Oregon, gathered at a temporary memorial near an elementary school to grieve the victims of a shooting.

item.title: AOC Directs $1M to Michigan Hopeful El-Sayed to Fight Attacks
item.description: Potential 2028 contender Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez has directed one million dollars toward the campaign of progressive Michigan candidate Abdul El-Sayed. She stated the financial backing aims to counter political attacks targeting him.

item.title: ASK Demands Impartial Probe and Trial for Journalist Alif's Murder
item.description: Ain o Salakand Kendra stated that killing a reporter threatens free journalism, freedom of speech, and the public's right to information. The organization has called for an unbiased investigation and justice in the case.

item.title: Oldest Western Hemisphere Dwelling Uncovered at Alaska Site
item.description: Researchers in Alaska have uncovered a 13,800-year-old base camp featuring signs of the earliest known residence in the Americas. The location also contains indicators pointing to early domesticated dogs in the region.

item.title: Main Suspect Arrested with Firearm in Narayanganj Shooting Death
item.description: Rony, the primary suspect in the public shooting death of Saheb Ali in Siddhirganj, Narayanganj, was captured by the RAB alongside a pistol and ammunition. Law enforcement is actively searching for the remaining suspects.

item.title: BLAST Demands Action Against Instigators in Satkhira Beating Death
item.description: Following the public beating death of a young man in Satkhira, BLAST has demanded legal proceedings for all involved parties and instigators. The incident followed the October 12 circulation of a private audio recording involving the victim and his wife on social media.

item.title: Indian National Receives Life Sentence for UK Brothel Murder
item.description: An Indian citizen convicted of killing a woman he encountered at a brothel in the United Kingdom has been sentenced to life imprisonment.

item.title: Cover Revealed for Nasreen Jahan's New Novel Phoenix Tomake Mayabasi
item.description: During an event unveiling the cover of Nasreen Jahan's latest book, speaker Mazharul Islam referenced Ernest Hemingway's moveable feast quote. He described the author's lifestyle as mirroring an ongoing, continuous celebration.

item.title: Physicists Observe Century-Old Quantum Prediction in Atom Necklace
item.description: Researchers successfully trapped atoms in a single row, observing behaviors consistent with century-old quantum theories regarding cluster formations known as Bethe strings. Although the findings remain indirect, the experiment highlights complex atomic interactions.

item.title: New Jersey Deputy Attorney General Arrested on AI CSAM Charges
item.description: Law enforcement officials arrested a New Jersey deputy prosecutor following a Discord user's report regarding the creation of artificial intelligence-generated child sexual abuse material.

item.title: রাজনৈতিক দলগুলোর মধ্যে মৌলিক সংস্কারে মতপার্থক্য
item.description: জুলাই সনদ বাস্তবায়ন নিয়ে সরকারি ও বিরোধী দলের মধ্যে ভিন্ন অবস্থান দেখা গেছে। বিরোধী দল গণভোটের রায় কার্যকর করার দাবি জানিয়েছে, আর সরকার পক্ষ স্বাক্ষরিত সনদ অনুযায়ী তা বাস্তবায়ন করতে চায়।

item.title: Houthi Strikes Target Government-Held City of Aden in Yemen
item.description: Yemen's official government seat in Aden faced missile strikes from Iran-backed Houthi insurgents. This assault followed a previous attack on an Aden palace complex by the same group.
